findings.title: Topic-map h3 colour silently changes from primary 20% to 50%
findings.body: The `.topic-map h3` colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, so the primary-side lightness moved from 20% to 50% and the secondary side is 50% instead of the original 20%-equivalent. The PR is described as a dark-theme fix, so this change in the light-theme colour is unintended and not called out. Restore the 20%/80% pairing used elsewhere for this heading, or document the intentional change.

findings.title: Custom message length colour changes primary lightness from 70% to 30%
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a light grey. It is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, so the light-theme colour becomes much darker. The rest of this PR only adds a $secondary branch and keeps the primary value, so this is an unannounced visual regression on mobile modals.

findings.title: Group member name colour changes from primary 30% to 50%
findings.body: In `.group-member-info .name`, the original colour was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The primary lightness changed from 30% to 50%, so the name is noticeably lighter on light themes. This is not part of a dark-theme-only fix and is not mentioned.

findings.title: Mobile group member name colour changes from primary 30% to 50%
findings.body: Same change as the desktop file: `.group-member-info .name` was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` and is now the 50%/50% `dark-light-choose` pair. The light-theme colour is altered without being noted in the PR, so it should be restored to the 30%/70% pairing or the change should be explained.

findings.title: Comment still describes the old scale-color default
findings.body: The comment above `.coldmap-*` says the default table cell colour is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. The code now uses `dark-light-choose(...)` for that default, so the comment is stale and misleads future maintainers.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder
findings.body: The description reads only 'Test 7'. It does not explain why `dark-light-choose` is being applied across 32 stylesheets, nor does it mention the several places where the primary lightness value was also changed. A reviewer cannot judge intent or scope from it.
